description: This file defines an abstract class for validating URI components for different URI schemes within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties for default port, security, hierarchy, and methods for validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme
classes.description: Abstract class for URI scheme validation, providing properties and methods for validating URI components based on specific schemes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of URI components, applying default actions and calling the specific doValidate method.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Abstract method to implement specific validation logic for URI schemes; called by validate.
